title: Polymarket Gamma CS2 series markets carry tag_slug=counter-strike-2 rather than tag_slug=cs2 (repaired)
detail: Line-by-line review of scripts/sources.py (lines 252 and 278) against live Gamma API responses on 2026-10-21 showed that gamma-api.polymarket.com/events?tag_slug=cs2 returns only two season-long outright markets and zero active match moneylines, whereas all active CS2 series markets carry tag id 100780 (slug 'counter-strike-2') without tag slug 'cs2'. As a result, poly_index() and gamma_games() dropped every non-directory low-tier Polymarket match event before exact or alias matching. Fixed in scripts/sources.py and scripts/originate.py so both tag slugs ('counter-strike-2' and legacy 'cs2') discover and replay identically.

title: Zetta vs LOS NINOS (1082837): 5/5 org name change to Alianza Lima Esports and wide Polymarket order book
detail: Hotspawn fixture 1082837 ('Zetta vs LOS NINOS', 2026-10-21T22:00:00Z, CCT South America 2026 Series #7) corresponds to HLTV match 2399865 (Zetta five-player roster Slayerhz, zockie, NotJuanjo, BabyRage, Antuanette — 5/5 match with Valve Americas VRS #357 Zetta, 473 pts) and to Polymarket event cs2-ale1-ln-2026-10-21 / bo3.gg match 132583 ('Alianza Lima Esports vs Los Niños'). LOS NINOS has only five completed series on bo3.gg (below the 8-series minimum of scripts/form_model.py), and the live Polymarket Match Winner CLOB book (condition 0xc9860063e80733984457b6cf6829533c14c45089b3d413edc18dbf99c97a10a7) has a wide bid/ask spread above the 0.15 money-line ceiling, so when no tighter bookmaker/exchange line is posted at refresh time it resolves only on the amber-badged wide-book guidance rung with explicit spread disclosure.

title: Diacritic stripping in scripts/form_model.py and bo3.gg host allowlist in scripts/audit_rows.py (repaired)
detail: Line-by-line code review identified three latent defects: (1) form_model.key() stripped accented Latin letters without Unicode NFKD decomposition, turning 'Grêmio' into 'grmio' instead of 'gremio' and 'Los Niños' into 'losnios' instead of 'losninos'; (2) collect_bo3_results() matched upcoming bo3.gg fixtures only on unaliased names; (3) scripts/audit_rows.py omitted bo3.gg from OFFICIAL even though build.py renders bo3.gg series links inside model evidence tables, and build.py labeled HLTV-ranking and bo3.gg-results model links as 'Valve'. Repaired across scripts/form_model.py, scripts/originate.py, scripts/audit_rows.py and scripts/build.py.

title: Post-deploy audit: Executive Summary home #unresolved register lists featured-only rejections after fallback resolution
detail: Direct verification of production Pages deployment 7228224801 (run 39612934455 on commit 586af66, observed 2026-10-21T14:15:34Z) confirmed 12 of 12 active upcoming Hotspawn CS2 matches resolved with directional picks and 0 unresolved on /origination/#unresolved (3 consensus, 5 market, 3 model, 1 wide-book guidance; 521 audited rows, 0 violations). However, on the home Executive Summary page (/), the top hero and 'Picks at a glance' report '12 of 12 with a pick' and '0 explicitly unresolved' while the 'Unresolved picks & limitations' section directly beneath still reads featured-only latest.json ('5 of 12 active Hotspawn CS2 fixtures have no verified pick in this snapshot'). Flagged for the active scripts/build.py owner so home #unresolved matches /origination/#unresolved while retaining featured-only rejections on /review/#unresolved.
